# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 17 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Adam Sends Seth for the Oil of Mercy

---

**17:1** And Adam called Seth to him and said: 'My son Seth, hasten to paradise, you and your mother Eve, and take a little of the oil of mercy from the tree of mercy, that I may be anointed and may rest from this pain.'

**17:2** And Seth said to his father: 'Father, I do not know the way to paradise, and I have not seen the way since we were expelled.'

**17:3** And Adam said to him: 'Go to the east of paradise, and you will find footprints of your mother and myself, for we walked together in that place. Follow our footprints and you will find the gate.'

**17:4** And Seth arose and took his mother Eve by the hand and went toward paradise.

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
